name: Cancellation Rebooking Rule
description: If a flight is cancelled by the airline, customer is entitled to free rebooking on the next available flight within 24 hours OR a full refund. Customer chooses. The supplied data does not provide actual alternative flight schedules or availability.
citation: Service Rules Section 5.1: Cancellation Rebooking Rule

name: Delay Compensation Rule
description: Delay under 3 hours: ₹500 meal voucher. Delay more than 3 hours: meal voucher + lounge access. Delay more than 5 hours: meal voucher + lounge access + hotel accommodation for delayed hours only (NOT full night).
citation: Service Rules Section 5.2: Delay Compensation Rule

name: Refund Processing Rule
description: Refunds for airline-caused cancellations are processed in full within 7 business days, issued ONLY to the original payment method. Do not promise an alternative payment method or cash payouts.
citation: Service Rules Section 5.3: Refund Processing Rule

name: Fare Difference Rule
description: If a customer voluntarily chooses to rebook on a higher-fare flight, customer must pay the fare difference. Agents cannot waive fare differences above ₹1,500 without supervisor approval. Fare difference <= ₹1,500: agent may handle. Fare difference > ₹1,500: supervisor approval required.
citation: Service Rules Section 5.4: Fare Difference Rule

name: Loyalty Tier Rule
description: Gold and Platinum customers receive priority rebooking and first access to next-available seats, but NO additional compensation beyond standard policy. No free upgrades or extra payouts based on tier.
citation: Service Rules Section 5.5: Loyalty Tier Rule

name: Prohibited Actions & Mandatory Escalation
description: The agent must escalate to human support when: (1) customer requests compensation beyond policy, (2) fare difference waiver > ₹1,500, (3) exception for non-airline disruption, (4) threat of legal action, (5) threat of formal complaint, (6) refund to different payment method.
